turns.question: At which hour of the day were the most page views recorded between 20 September and 3 October 2026, and how many page views were in that hour?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no page views by hour (its time grain is the day), so the peak hour and its count cannot be given; the closest metric, customer actions filtered to page_view, totals 10 page views from 20 September to 3 October 2026, with the most on 1 October (5). Late: customer_actions.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
